recommendation: Keep the commit. It fixes the remaining active FHIR ModelInfo surface for the seed issue as refined by FHIR-32584; any QUICK or historical model-definition cleanup should be handled under a separate tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-25773 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to move DocumentReference.masterIdentifier into DocumentReference.content.identifier and adjust the identifier search parameter.
initial_application: No local commit subject directly names FHIR-25773, but git history shows the July 2020 DocumentReference block-vote commit 0bf0b46a829ce94829ceef7e036dcb2043c74d18 removed masterIdentifier from DocumentReference examples and added content.identifier in the spreadsheet/example source.
additional_context: FHIR-32584 later superseded the content.identifier model by removing DocumentReference.content.identifier and clarifying that business identifiers belong on DocumentReference.identifier. Current DocumentReference source and search parameters already use DocumentReference.identifier, and fhir.ini maps the old R4 masterIdentifier to DocumentReference.identifier. The active FHIR ModelInfo Library still had masterIdentifier before this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Removed DocumentReference.masterIdentifier from source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml and regenerated the embedded base64 payload in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml. Did not add content.identifier because the later final model is DocumentReference.identifier.
source_changes: Regenerated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so the embedded Library.data payload matches the updated ModelInfo content.
